_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Comment on the whole image, and Escape discards. "The overlay" is ".image-comment-overlay"; "the frame" is ".image-comment-overlay .image-comment-frame" (it shrink-wraps the image, so its box is the image's displayed pixels and a fraction of it is a fraction of the image). "Drag from (a, b) to (c, d)" means: move the mouse over the frame at offsets (a × its width, b × its height) from its top-left, press the left button, move to (c × width, d × height) in N steps (5 unless said otherwise), and release; read the frame's box with getBoundingClientRect when computing the offsets. "Drag the middle half" is a drag from (0.25, 0.25) to (0.75, 0.75). The open comment dialog has its title ".diff-viewer-comment-dialog-handle" (it names the region being commented on), its input ".diff-viewer-comment-input" and its button "Add Comment" (name exactly that). window.geometry() returns the WxH+X+Y region the dialog title names; window.middleHalf(W, H) returns "ok" if that region is the middle half of a WxH image, within tolerance, and otherwise what is off; window.keepGeometry() keeps the current geometry for later, and window.kept(i) returns the i-th one kept (from 0). Check the message input's (data-testid "message-input") value with an eval comparing it to the exact string, building it with window.kept(i) where it says G or Gi; \n is a newline. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/inline. Wait (up to 30s) for the image ".markdown-content img[src*=\"shelley-inline-image-demo.png\"]" to be visible. Click it. The overlay should be visible.
2. Escape backs out of the open comment first, leaving the view up: the text being abandoned is the thing Escape is most likely meant for. Click the overlay's button "Comment on the whole image", fill the dialog's input with "abandoned", and press Escape. There should be no dialog input (count 0), the overlay should still be visible, and the message input's value should be exactly "".
3. A second Escape closes the view, still without touching the composer: press Escape. The overlay should be gone (count 0), and the message input's value still exactly "".
4. Markdown images are keyboard-reachable: Enter on a focused image opens the view, same as a click. Focus the image (a one-shot eval calling its focus()) and press Enter. The overlay should be visible.
5. A whole-image comment says so in the dialog title, and in the header it writes, instead of naming a region: click "Comment on the whole image"; the dialog's title should contain "whole image". Fill the input with "looks good overall" and click "Add Comment". The message input's value should be exactly "> image shelley-inline-image-demo.png [whole image, 48x48]\nlooks good overall\n\n".

> image shelley-inline-image-demo.png [whole image, 48x48]
looks good overall
